methodology: discovery → density → residual IC → stack validation → role assignment (base | satellite | enhancer | drop)

alpha_role_taxonomy.return_alpha: Strong IC — ranks stocks by expected return (e.g. winner_sentiment_reversal)
alpha_role_taxonomy.portfolio_alpha: Improves stack Sharpe without strong standalone IC ranking (rare)
alpha_role_taxonomy.conditional_enhancer: State variable — improves when/how base alpha works (e.g. amihud_shock, cancel_shock)
alpha_role_taxonomy.research_satellite: Independent information source, not stable production weight (D4 max_return, gain_exhaustion, D3 lower_shadow)
alpha_role_taxonomy.drop: Redundant to an existing base source; no residual IC and/or negative stack uplift
